data.gender_notes: Deepanshu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Deepanshu means deep knowledge, understanding, or insight. This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'deep' meaning deep and 'anshu' meaning knowledge. The name Deepanshu carries the meaning “Deep knowledge, understanding” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Deepanshu usually hope their child will grow to embody deep knowledge, understanding and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Deepanshu is a spiritual name that represents the deepest understanding of the universe and the self. It is a name for those who seek knowledge and wisdom, and who are dedicated to the pursuit of truth.
data.etymology: Deepanshu belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Deep knowledge, understanding.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Deepanshu total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

This name is often given to babies as a reminder of the importance of knowledge and wisdom in life.
